title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

hints.content: dp[i] = length of LIS ending at index i.
For each j < i: if nums[j] < nums[i], dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1).
Can be solved in O(n^2) via standard DP, or O(n log n) with patient sorting / binary search.

solution.explanation:
Classic O(n^2) dynamic programming checking all preceding smaller elements.
Time Complexity: O(n^2)
Space Complexity: O(n)
